scope: Focused manual source review supplementing actual independent host behavior tests; no native or release authorization.

retained_state.interpretation: One latest WindowFacts replaces its predecessor. One resource, pending drain, operation and presentation use fixed slots. Consumed operation/drain/presentation references are cleared or replaced. No production history is retained. Caller-owned object graphs are not a whole-heap bound.

construction_paths: Retirement emits terminal SEAL, CANCEL_QUEUED, UNREGISTER, then optionally one CLOSE: maximum four.
Ordinary invalidation/observation emits SEAL and optionally QUEUE_DRAIN or a drain-started operation: maximum two.
Epoch exhaustion immediately retires; phase checks prevent subsequent scheduling/begin.
Completion emits one pending refresh drain, one deferred close, no decisions, or the terminal batch.
Each method allocates a local list only when needed; batch returns List.copyOf and enforces the declared bound.

thread_checks.result: All 18 methods invoke thread.requireOwner before state checks/observations/mutations. Both constructor entries reach the seeded constructor's trusted assertion before argument validation or externally observable ownership. Immutable record accessors are value reads, not live-owner entries.
thread_checks.assumption: Injected checker is trusted, nonreentrant and either checks or throws; this does not prove Android main Looper identity.

resource_and_terminal_review.result: Matching operation identity is required before any resource processing. Only OPEN_INITIAL may first adopt an acquired nonnull identity, including after retirement. Refresh/input require the existing identity and cannot replace it. Retirement precedes cleanup decisions and revokes input/presentation/drain. Deferred close waits for matching operation completion and close-token allocation prevents duplicates. Cleanup report is first-result-per-token and does not establish actual successful reclamation.
resource_and_terminal_review.never_returning_operation: Remains recorded and terminally fenced; no deferred CLOSE is emitted until its matching completion. Actual reclamation stays pending.

identity_and_epoch_review.result: Identity comparisons use reference equality, not value equality. Epoch maximum retires without increment/wrap; operationEpoch comparisons preserve later dirtiness. Token instances are private-constructor identities and no production token history is retained.
